repos_data.description: A keyboard-first menubar app to monitor and jump between AI coding sessions — minimum setup required.
Manage multiple Claude Code, OpenCode agents from either TUI or Web for easy access on mobile. Also supports Mistral Vibe, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Pi.dev, Copilot CLI, Factory Droid Coding.
Ultra-fast token & cost tracker for LLM Token Usage (e.g. Claude Code)
Persistent, agent-agnostic session memory for AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, opencode). One Markdown vault, any agent.
Local-first Rust TUI/CLI for auditing AI coding-agent sessions: cost, tokens, latency, failures, and health｜本地优先 Rust TUI/CLI，审计 AI 编程 Agent 会话的成本、Token、延迟、失败与健康度
A zsh plugin to sync tmux window names with ssh sessions

Self-maintaining and persistent codebase memory for AI coding agents — a deterministic AST index plus agent-written notes that flag themselves stale when the code changes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via MCP + CLI.
Long-term, cross-project memory for AI coding agents. Your own Obsidian vault as the source of truth. Daemonless and without opaque databases, your memory belongs to you.
Your AI forgets everything between sessions. SAME fixes that. Local-first, no API keys, single binary.
Let AI agents message, watch, and spawn each other across terminals. Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, Kilo, Pi, Kimi
A macOS hotkey that opens your terminal at the right repo with your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, …) already running. Free, open source, local-only.

repo_meta_data.description: The fastest shell shortcut to resume your recent AI coding sessions in the terminal
